summary: element-guci-util ships a date-gated on-import browser DoS and forced.exe download redirecting to admin.nikolive.cn
details: The package main (time.js) invokes iconFont() at top level on import. A date check gates the payload to activate on or after 2026-10-01; before that date the branch is a no-op, hiding the behavior from review. After the trigger date, imported code runs unbounded CPU/memory loops and paints a full-page canvas overlay to freeze the host browser, then on a 500ms interval synthesizes a Blob download named index.png.exe, opens a window to https://admin.nikolive.cn/, and calls location.reload(true) — repeatedly prompting the end-user to save an executable-named file and hammering the external domain. Cover-story naming (iconFont/iconDont/silentInfiniteLoad, description 'element-ui utility functions') and placeholder author/repo metadata ('你的名字', '你的git仓库地址') disguise the payload. The manifest also declares the package itself as a dependency at an unpinned caret range (element-guci-util: ^9.9.9), a self-referencing dependency-confusion shape that lets a controller of that name/version deliver additional attacker code at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
